name: jev
title: Jev: TypeSafe decision model, typed questions
description: Jev answers typed questions about the masked month with probabilities. Two funds: P(stocks beat bonds), a 5-way tilt whose probability-weighted points (+3, +1.5, 0, -1.5, -3) are the stated view, and a confidence. Three funds: P(SPY beats IEF), P(LQD beats IEF), P(best fund) per fund; the stated view is P(best) - 1/3.
author: Diwas
